agent.first_message: Hello there! I'm a little gnome with a rather large wardrobe. Fancy choosing my next look?

prompt.prompt: Replaced with agent-prompt.txt by the setup script.

tools.name: perform_gesture
tools.description: Animate your visible body. Use when asked to wave, dance, bow, celebrate or shrug, or when the gesture naturally fits your reply.

tools.name: set_expression
tools.description: Change your visible facial expression when a reaction naturally fits the conversation. Reset to neutral after a strong reaction.

tools.name: get_wardrobe
tools.description: Read your currently worn clothing, available complete looks and available individual clothing items. Call before choosing a new look or answering wardrobe questions. The items are the complete supported wardrobe.

tools.name: change_outfit
tools.description: Actually change your visible clothing. You can pick a complete named look and/or override individual pieces. Wait for success=true before saying the clothes changed. This also performs a small bow; no separate bow tool is needed. Keep unrelated pieces when a user asks for a single change.

look.description: Start from this complete look. Use custom for individual changes preserving unspecified current pieces.

headwear.description: Optional override. Explicit keep retains the currently worn piece even with a new complete look. Omit to use the named look, or retain the current piece for custom. Choices: powdered_wig=Powdered curly wig, blond_hair=Swept blond hair, red_hat=Classic red gnome hat, baseball_cap=Red and white baseball cap, pirate_hat=Pirate tricorn and red bandana, chef_hat=Pirate chef hat, hard_hat=Work hard hat, pharaoh_headdress=Blue and gold Egyptian headdress, mail_cap=Blue mail carrier cap, dragon_helmet=Green dragon helmet

glasses.description: Optional override. Explicit keep retains the currently worn piece even with a new complete look. Omit to use the named look, or retain the current piece for custom. Choices: round_glasses=Round spectacles, eye_patch=Pirate eye patch, gold_sunglasses=Gold-framed sunglasses

shirt.description: Optional override. Explicit keep retains the currently worn piece even with a new complete look. Omit to use the named look, or retain the current piece for custom. Choices: safety_vest=Orange reflective safety vest, checked_shirt=Blue checked shirt, blue_shirt=Plain blue shirt, baseball_shirt=Baseball shirt, pirate_jacket=Pirate jacket, chef_coat=Pirate chef coat, work_jacket=Work jacket, egyptian_collar=Egyptian collar, egyptian_tunic=Egyptian tunic, mail_uniform=Mail carrier uniform, dragon_armor=Green dragon armor, royal_tunic=Royal gold tunic, captain_jacket=Purple and gold captain jacket, fur_coat=White fur coat

pants.description: Optional override. Explicit keep retains the currently worn piece even with a new complete look. Omit to use the named look, or retain the current piece for custom. Choices: patchwork_shorts=Patchwork shorts, work_trousers=Work trousers, classic_trousers=Classic trousers, baseball_trousers=Baseball trousers, pirate_trousers=Pirate trousers, chef_trousers=Chef trousers, worker_trousers=Worker trousers, egyptian_farmer=Egyptian farmer clothing, egyptian_guard=Egyptian guard clothing, mail_trousers=Mail carrier trousers

Choices: red_boots=Classic red boots, work_boots=Work boots, classic_shoes=Classic shoes, baseball_shoes=Baseball shoes, pirate_boots=Pirate boots, worker_boots=Worker boots, mail_shoes=Mail carrier shoes, dragon_boots=Dragon claw boots
